criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Official store address/name corroborated by Purdue store listing and OSM way 117396621 (University Book Store, 360 W State St); in a fresh Blender process the shell’s nine source ring vertices match the raw OSM polygon after the documented local transform.
criteria.deduction: None for this criterion; OSM is a volunteer mapped outline, not a survey.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.status: position/orientation/plan verified; absolute site placement pending coordinator integration
criteria.evidence: The source ring is transformed with project X-east/Y-north local approximation; measured plan bounds are 34.53 × 38.86 m, max ring-vertex error 0.00000072 m. Nominatim address point converts to campus anchor (306.429, -351.852) m.
criteria.deduction: Campus location is represented as a documented local anchor but validation says master integration is pending; no surveyed control point or authoritative dimensions were available.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The fresh-open shell is 4.28 m to its flat roof; the asset extends to 13.77 m (builder reports retail parapet about 6.15 m and glazed corner about 13.4 m). Source street photograph visibly supports a low flat-roof shop with a distinctly taller glazed corner.
criteria.deduction: No measured elevations, roof plan, or authoritative floor count were found. The height values and multi-level interpretation remain image-derived estimates; rooftop form/equipment are unverified.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.status: strong street-photo match with minor simplifications
criteria.evidence: Direct comparison with the cited Google-credited storefront image supports red brick, broad pale parapet with pilasters, long ribbed pale awning, display glazing, paired west-side entry, white UNIVERSITY BOOK STORE lettering, and taller glazed east corner. The rendered front view contains these features.
criteria.deduction: The model simplifies the corner’s stepped/canted cream surround and presents the frontage with a cleaner, more regular window rhythm; the back and side elevations and the interior remain inferred/schematic.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.status: asset/export and dependency checks verified; integration pending
criteria.evidence: Fresh-open asset contains the expected named scene and collection; 538/538 asset objects are directly linked to that collection. No external libraries or unpacked file images. Procedural materials, raw OSM snapshot, provenance/evidence, roof-plan/front previews, and validation are present.
criteria.deduction: Coordinator-owned manifest/placement/master integration is explicitly pending. Evidence states source date, retrieval date, CRS, method, and uncertainty, but building/store source photos do not have capture date or metric camera calibration.

evidence.assignment: Root README ownership row names stable ID massing_university_book_store_717bf2c, the same asset path, and owner Tobin.

findings: Passes the requested 8/10 threshold at 8.25/10, with material height and absolute-placement uncertainty retained.
Keep height/floor labels explicitly estimated until a measured elevation, reliable height source, or calibrated imagery is available.
Complete and recheck the coordinator-owned master placement/integration before claiming campus placement fully verified.
For higher facade fidelity, refine the source-photo corner surround and document source-image date/camera uncertainty; do not scale geometry from the image without calibration.
